name: worktrees
description: Built-in WORKTREES explorer section: git worktrees of the active repo, each openable as its own tmux session — for running parallel agents/branches without collisions (bundled — see extensions/build.mjs).

worktrees.location.description: Where new worktrees are created. {repo} is the repository root, {branch} the branch name (path separators in it replaced with '-'). A relative path resolves against the repository root. When the location is inside the repository, its top folder is added to .git/info/exclude so it stays out of git status (your committed .gitignore is never modified).

worktrees.agents.description: Agent presets offered by the create-worktree form's "Start agent" picker, as a JSON array of {name, command}. command is typed into the new session and submitted right after it's created. Leave as [] to disable the picker.
